issues.on_page: Property 1,510,222 / Motor Vehicle 96,331 / Other 8,978 (General Fund column, p4)

issues.issue: The category rests only on the fund names (and statute). Nothing in the trimmed PDF or the full report's notes says lodging, so under the evidence standard ('fund names alone are never evidence') this is unproven. The statement line for the same money stays taxes (unlabeled)
Category rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation (Loup County records the same kind of line that way). The report itself prints it under the Public Works heading
